description: This file contains a function 'copyPrompt' that generates a detailed prompt message for Playwright test failure analysis, including error details, test info, code snippets, and diffs. It also includes a utility to strip ANSI escape codes.

methods.name: copyPrompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt message based on test errors, stdout/stderr, code frame, and git diff.

methods.name: stripAnsiEscapes
methods.description: Removes ANSI escape codes from a string.
